<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>School Farm — 農業人口を1億人にする会社</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Zen+Old+Mincho:wght@400;500;600;700;900&family=Noto+Serif+JP:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400;1,700&family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ── TOKENS ───────────────────────────────── */
:root {
  --ink:     #0a0b08;
  --deep:    #111309;
  --surface: #161810;
  --panel:   #1e2116;
  --border:  rgba(180,163,100,.12);
  --gold:    #c8a145;
  --gold-dim:#7a6128;
  --parchment:#f0ece0;
  --fog:     #d8d2c0;
  --muted:   rgba(216,210,192,.55);
  --green:   #5e8040;
  --leaf:    #8fb866;
  --mist:    rgba(143,184,102,.15);
  --accent:  #d4622a;
  --r: .4rem;
}

*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;cursor:none}
body{
  font-family:'Noto Serif JP',serif;
  background:var(--ink);
  color:var(--fog);
  overflow-x:hidden;
  line-height:1.7;
}

/* Custom cursor */
#cursor{
  position:fixed;width:10px;height:10px;
  background:var(--leaf);border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition:width .2s,height .2s,background .2s;
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
}
#cursor-ring{
  position:fixed;width:32px;height:32px;
  border:1px solid rgba(143,184,102,.4);
  border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition:transform .08s linear,width .3s,height .3s;
}
body:has(a:hover,button:hover,.biz-card:hover) #cursor{
  width:20px;height:20px;background:var(--gold);
}

/* ── PAGE SYSTEM ───────────────────────────── */
.page{display:none}
.page.active{display:block}
.page{animation:pagein .5s ease both}
@keyframes pagein{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ── NAV ───────────────────────────────────── */
nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 52px;height:60px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  background:rgba(10,11,8,.85);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
}
.nav-logo{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:16px;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--parchment);letter-spacing:.06em;
  cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
}
.nav-dot{
  width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--leaf);
  animation:blink 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:32px;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;
  transition:color .2s;font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  padding-bottom:2px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--parchment);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.nav-contact{
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-dim);
  padding:7px 20px;cursor:pointer;background:none;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  transition:all .2s;
}
.nav-contact:hover{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}

/* ── HERO ───────────────────────────────────── */
.hero{
  min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:flex-end;padding:60px 52px 80px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--ink);
}

/* Animated gradient orbs */
.hero-orb{
  position:absolute;border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;filter:blur(80px);
}
.hero-orb-1{
  width:500px;height:500px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(94,128,64,.3),transparent 70%);
  top:-100px;right:-100px;
  animation:float1 8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.hero-orb-2{
  width:400px;height:400px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(200,161,69,.12),transparent 70%);
  bottom:0;left:10%;
  animation:float2 10s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.hero-orb-3{
  width:300px;height:300px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,98,42,.08),transparent 70%);
  top:40%;left:50%;
  animation:float3 12s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes float1{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(-40px,30px)}}
@keyframes float2{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(30px,-40px)}}
@keyframes float3{0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,0)}50%{transform:translate(-50%,-30px)}}

/* Grain overlay */
.grain{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.035;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 512 512' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.75' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  background-size:200px;
}

.hero-eyebrow{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.35em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:28px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  opacity:0;animation:reveal .8s .2s ease forwards;
}
.hero-eyebrow::before{
  content:'';width:40px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-dim);
}

.hero-h1{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:clamp(60px,10vw,130px);
  font-weight:900;line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
  color:var(--parchment);
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  margin-bottom:20px;
  opacity:0;animation:reveal .9s .3s ease forwards;
}
.hero-h1 .counter-wrap{
  display:inline-block;
  color:var(--leaf);
  position:relative;
}
.hero-h1 .en-sub{
  display:block;
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-style:italic;font-weight:400;
  font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,36px);
  color:var(--gold);
  letter-spacing:.04em;
  margin-top:8px;
}

.hero-desc{
  max-width:480px;font-size:14px;line-height:2.1;
  color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:48px;
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  opacity:0;animation:reveal .8s .5s ease forwards;
}

.hero-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  opacity:0;animation:reveal .8s .65s ease forwards;
}
.hero-btn-primary{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  background:var(--green);color:var(--parchment);
  padding:14px 32px;font-size:12px;
  letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  cursor:pointer;border:none;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 12px) 0,100% 12px,100% 100%,12px 100%,0 calc(100% - 12px));
  transition:background .2s,transform .2s;
}
.hero-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--leaf);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.hero-btn-ghost{
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  transition:color .2s;
}
.hero-btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--parchment)}
.hero-btn-ghost span{
  width:20px;height:1px;background:currentColor;
  transition:width .3s;
}
.hero-btn-ghost:hover span{width:32px}

/* hero bottom bar */
.hero-bar{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  display:flex;gap:0;margin-top:60px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:32px;
}
.hero-stat{
  flex:1;padding-right:32px;
  border-right:1px solid var(--border);
  margin-right:32px;
}
.hero-stat:last-child{border-right:none;margin-right:0}
.hero-stat-num{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:28px;color:var(--gold);
  font-weight:700;line-height:1;margin-bottom:6px;
}
.hero-stat-label{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
}

@keyframes reveal{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ── TICKER ─────────────────────────────────── */
.ticker{
  background:var(--gold);overflow:hidden;
  height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;
}
.ticker-inner{
  display:flex;gap:48px;
  animation:ticker 20s linear infinite;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.ticker-item{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
}
.ticker-sep{color:rgba(10,11,8,.3)}
@keyframes ticker{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ── ABOUT ─────────────────────────────────── */
.about{
  padding:120px 52px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:80px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;
  align-items:start;
}
.about-label{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.35em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
}
.about-label::before{content:'';width:32px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-dim)}
.about-h2{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,52px);font-weight:700;
  line-height:1.3;color:var(--parchment);
  margin-bottom:32px;
}
.about-h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--leaf)}
.about-body{font-size:14px;line-height:2.2;color:var(--muted)}
.about-body p{margin-bottom:20px}
.about-right{padding-top:60px}
.mvv-block{margin-bottom:48px;padding-left:24px;border-left:2px solid var(--border)}
.mvv-block:hover{border-left-color:var(--leaf);transition:border-color .3s}
.mvv-label{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px;
}
.mvv-title{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:18px;
  color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:600;
}
.mvv-body{font-size:13px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted)}

/* ── BIZ SECTION ───────────────────────────── */
.biz-section{padding:60px 0 120px}
.biz-header{
  padding:0 52px 60px;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;
}
.biz-header-left .section-eyebrow{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.35em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:16px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
}
.biz-header-left .section-eyebrow::before{content:'';width:32px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-dim)}
.biz-header h2{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:clamp(28px,3.5vw,44px);font-weight:700;
  color:var(--parchment);line-height:1.3;
}
.biz-header-right{
  font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;letter-spacing:.1em;
}

/* Horizontal scroll */
.biz-scroll-wrap{
  overflow-x:auto;padding:0 52px;
  scrollbar-width:none;
  display:flex;gap:2px;
}
.biz-scroll-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}

.biz-card{
  flex-shrink:0;width:360px;
  background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:44px 36px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .3s,transform .3s,border-color .3s;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.biz-card::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;
  bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;height:2px;
  background:var(--leaf);
  transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;
  transition:transform .4s ease;
}
.biz-card:hover{
  background:var(--panel);
  border-color:rgba(143,184,102,.2);
  transform:translateY(-4px);
}
.biz-card:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}

.biz-card-num{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:60px;font-weight:400;
  color:rgba(200,161,69,.1);
  line-height:1;margin-bottom:16px;
  transition:color .3s;
}
.biz-card:hover .biz-card-num{color:rgba(143,184,102,.15)}
.biz-card-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:20px;display:block}
.biz-card-title{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:20px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:6px;
}
.biz-card-en{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-style:italic;font-size:11px;
  color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.biz-card-body{font-size:12px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px}
.biz-card-tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:28px}
.biz-tag{
  font-size:9px;padding:3px 10px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  border:1px solid rgba(143,184,102,.2);
  color:var(--leaf);font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.biz-card-cta{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  transition:color .2s;
}
.biz-card:hover .biz-card-cta{color:var(--leaf)}
.biz-card-cta-arrow{
  width:16px;height:1px;background:currentColor;
  transition:width .3s;position:relative;
}
.biz-card-cta-arrow::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;right:0;top:-3px;
  width:7px;height:7px;border-top:1px solid currentColor;
  border-right:1px solid currentColor;
  transform:rotate(45deg);
}
.biz-card:hover .biz-card-cta-arrow{width:28px}

/* ── PARTNER (小林精密) ───────────────────── */
.partner{
  background:var(--deep);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  padding:100px 52px;
}
.partner-grid-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(200,161,69,.03) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(200,161,69,.03) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:60px 60px;
}
.partner-inner{
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:100px;align-items:center;
  position:relative;z-index:2;
}
.partner-left .section-eyebrow{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.35em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
}
.partner-left .section-eyebrow::before{content:'';width:32px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-dim)}
.partner-h2{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:clamp(28px,3.5vw,44px);font-weight:700;
  color:var(--parchment);line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:28px;
}
.partner-h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--leaf)}
.partner-body{font-size:13px;line-height:2.2;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:36px}

/* Kobayashi badge */
.kobayashi-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  padding:20px 28px;margin-bottom:28px;
  position:relative;
  transition:border-color .3s;
}
.kobayashi-badge:hover{border-color:rgba(200,161,69,.3)}
.kobayashi-badge::before{
  content:'MANUFACTURING PARTNER';
  position:absolute;top:-8px;left:16px;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;
  background:var(--deep);padding:0 8px;
  color:var(--gold);
}
.kb-icon{
  width:48px;height:48px;
  background:rgba(200,161,69,.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(200,161,69,.15);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0;
}
.kb-name{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);
}
.kb-role{font-size:10px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-top:2px}

.partner-specs-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;
}
.spec-item{
  border:1px solid var(--border);padding:20px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .3s,background .3s;
}
.spec-item:hover{
  border-color:rgba(143,184,102,.2);
  background:rgba(143,184,102,.04);
}
.spec-item::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;
  width:2px;height:100%;background:var(--gold-dim);
  transition:background .3s;
}
.spec-item:hover::before{background:var(--leaf)}
.spec-val{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);
  line-height:1;margin-bottom:6px;
}
.spec-unit{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.spec-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px}

.partner-right-detail{
  padding:48px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}
.partner-detail-title{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:20px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:24px;
}
.partner-detail-list{list-style:none}
.partner-detail-list li{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;
  font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);
  padding:14px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  line-height:1.7;
}
.partner-detail-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.partner-detail-list li::before{
  content:'';
  width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--leaf);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:6px;
}

/* ── WHY ─────────────────────────────────── */
.why{
  padding:120px 52px;
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;
}
.why-header{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:60px;margin-bottom:80px;align-items:end;
}
.why-h2{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:clamp(28px,3.5vw,44px);font-weight:700;
  color:var(--parchment);line-height:1.3;
}
.why-sub{font-size:13px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted)}
.why-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2px;
  background:var(--border);
}
.why-card{
  background:var(--ink);padding:40px 32px;
  transition:background .2s;
  border-top:2px solid transparent;
}
.why-card:hover{
  background:var(--surface);
  border-top-color:var(--leaf);
}
.why-num{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:48px;font-weight:400;
  color:rgba(200,161,69,.15);line-height:1;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.why-title{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:17px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:12px;
}
.why-body{font-size:12px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted)}

/* ── CUSTOMERS ──────────────────────────── */
.customers{
  background:var(--deep);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:100px 52px;
}
.customers-inner{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.logo-row{
  display:flex;justify-content:center;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  margin:60px 0 48px;overflow:hidden;
}
.logo-slot{
  flex:1;min-height:72px;
  border-right:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:background .2s;
}
.logo-slot:last-child{border-right:none}
.logo-slot:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.logo-placeholder{
  width:80px;height:24px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-radius:2px;
}
.logo-coming{
  text-align:center;font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:60px;
}
.voice-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2px;
  background:var(--border);
}
.voice-card{
  background:var(--surface);padding:40px 36px;
  transition:background .2s;
}
.voice-card:hover{background:var(--panel)}
.voice-tag{
  display:inline-block;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  border:1px solid rgba(143,184,102,.25);
  color:var(--leaf);padding:4px 12px;margin-bottom:20px;
}
.voice-q{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:48px;color:rgba(143,184,102,.15);
  line-height:1;margin-bottom:8px;
}
.voice-text{font-size:13px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px}
.voice-src{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--gold);
  text-transform:uppercase;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.voice-src::before{content:'';width:20px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-dim)}

/* ── TEAM ────────────────────────────────── */
.team{padding:120px 52px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.team-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:2px;background:var(--border);margin-top:60px;
}
.team-card{
  background:var(--surface);padding:40px 28px;
  transition:background .25s;
}
.team-card:hover{background:var(--panel)}
.team-avatar{
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--mist);border:1px solid rgba(143,184,102,.2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:20px;margin-bottom:20px;
}
.team-role-en{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:4px;
}
.team-name{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);
  margin-bottom:2px;
}
.team-name-roma{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-style:italic;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);
  margin-bottom:16px;
}
.team-quote{
  font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;
  color:var(--leaf);font-style:italic;
  border-left:1px solid var(--leaf);
  padding-left:12px;margin-bottom:16px;
}
.team-body{font-size:11px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--muted)}

/* ── CTA ─────────────────────────────────── */
.cta{
  background:var(--deep);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:120px 52px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.cta-orb{
  position:absolute;width:600px;height:600px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(94,128,64,.12),transparent 70%);
  border-radius:50%;top:50%;left:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.cta-inner{
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;
  position:relative;z-index:2;
}
.cta-h2{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,64px);font-weight:700;
  color:var(--parchment);line-height:1.25;
  text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px;
}
.cta-sub{
  text-align:center;font-size:14px;line-height:2;
  color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:72px;
}
.cta-cards{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:2px;background:var(--border);
}
.cta-card{
  background:var(--surface);padding:40px 36px;
  transition:background .2s;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.cta-card:hover{background:var(--panel)}
.cta-card-icon{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:16px}
.cta-card-title{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:17px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:12px;
}
.cta-card-body{font-size:12px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted);flex:1;margin-bottom:28px}
.cta-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--parchment);
  background:var(--green);padding:10px 20px;
  cursor:pointer;border:none;
  transition:background .2s;align-self:flex-start;
}
.cta-btn:hover{background:var(--leaf)}

/* ── FOOTER ──────────────────────────────── */
footer{
  background:var(--ink);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:60px 52px 40px;
}
.footer-inner{
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:48px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px;
}
.footer-logo{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--parchment);
  margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
}
.footer-tagline{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.1em}
.footer-links{display:flex;gap:24px;list-style:none}
.footer-links a{
  font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;
  cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  letter-spacing:.1em;transition:color .2s;
}
.footer-links a:hover{color:var(--parchment)}
.footer-bottom{
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;
  padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  font-size:10px;color:rgba(200,161,69,.3);letter-spacing:.1em;
}

/* ── DETAIL PAGES ────────────────────────── */
.detail-hero{
  min-height:60vh;padding:100px 52px 80px;
  background:var(--deep);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
}
.detail-hero-grid-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(200,161,69,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(200,161,69,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:48px 48px;
}
.detail-hero-orb{
  position:absolute;width:400px;height:400px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(94,128,64,.2),transparent 70%);
  border-radius:50%;right:-100px;top:-100px;
  pointer-events:none;filter:blur(60px);
}
.detail-hero-inner{
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;
  position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;
}
.detail-back{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;
  margin-bottom:32px;transition:color .2s;
}
.detail-back:hover{color:var(--parchment)}
.detail-back-line{width:20px;height:1px;background:currentColor;transition:width .3s}
.detail-back:hover .detail-back-line{width:32px}
.detail-eyebrow{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:20px;
}
.detail-h1{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:clamp(36px,5.5vw,72px);font-weight:700;
  line-height:1.15;color:var(--parchment);
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.detail-h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--leaf)}
.detail-hero-body{
  font-size:15px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted);max-width:560px;
}

.detail-content{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:80px 52px}

.detail-2col{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:80px;margin-bottom:80px;align-items:start;
}
.detail-lead-h{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;
  font-size:26px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);
  line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:24px;
}
.detail-lead-p{font-size:14px;line-height:2.2;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:16px}

.target-box{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:36px;
}
.target-box h3{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:16px;
  color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:20px;font-weight:600;
}
.target-list{list-style:none}
.target-list li{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;
  font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);
  padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  line-height:1.7;
}
.target-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.target-list li::before{
  content:'';width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--leaf);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:7px;
}

.feature-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:2px;background:var(--border);margin-bottom:80px;
}
.feature-card{
  background:var(--surface);padding:36px 28px;
  transition:background .2s;border-top:2px solid transparent;
}
.feature-card:hover{background:var(--panel);border-top-color:var(--leaf)}
.feature-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:16px;display:block}
.feature-title{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:17px;
  font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:10px;
}
.feature-body{font-size:12px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted)}

/* Kobayashi detail block */
.kobayashi-detail{
  background:var(--deep);border:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:60px;margin-bottom:80px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:60px;
  align-items:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.kobayashi-detail::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(200,161,69,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(200,161,69,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:40px 40px;
}
.kd-badge{
  position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;
}
.kd-icon{
  width:80px;height:80px;
  background:rgba(200,161,69,.07);
  border:1px solid rgba(200,161,69,.15);
  border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:32px;margin:0 auto 16px;
}
.kd-sub{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:6px;
}
.kd-name{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:14px;
  color:var(--parchment);font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;
}
.kd-content{position:relative;z-index:2}
.kd-content h3{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:22px;
  color:var(--parchment);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px;
}
.kd-content p{font-size:13px;line-height:2.2;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px}
.kd-specs{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.kd-spec{
  border:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 16px;
  font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.08em;
}

.detail-cta-block{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:60px;text-align:center;
}
.detail-cta-block h2{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:26px;
  font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:16px;
}
.detail-cta-block p{font-size:14px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:36px}
.detail-cta-btns{display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-gold{
  background:none;border:1px solid var(--gold-dim);
  color:var(--gold);padding:12px 28px;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
}
.btn-gold:hover{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}

/* ── SCROLL OBSERVER ─────────────────────── */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ── HAMBURGER ────────────────────────────── */
.hamburger{
  display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;
  cursor:pointer;padding:8px;background:none;border:none;
}
.hamburger span{
  display:block;width:22px;height:1.5px;
  background:var(--fog);transition:all .3s;
}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6.5px) rotate(45deg)}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6.5px) rotate(-45deg)}

.mobile-menu{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:60px 0 0 0;
  background:rgba(10,11,8,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  z-index:199;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:40px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
}
.mobile-menu.open{display:flex}
.mobile-menu a{
  font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:22px;
  color:var(--fog);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;
  letter-spacing:.05em;transition:color .2s;
}
.mobile-menu a:hover{color:var(--leaf)}
.mobile-menu .mobile-cta{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-dim);
  padding:12px 32px;margin-top:8px;
}

/* ── MOBILE ──────────────────────────────── */
@media(max-width:768px){
  /* Nav */
  nav{padding:0 20px}
  .nav-links{display:none}
  .nav-contact{display:none}
  .hamburger{display:flex}

  /* Hero */
  .hero{padding:88px 20px 60px}
  .hero-orb-1{width:300px;height:300px;top:-80px;right:-80px}
  .hero-orb-2{width:250px;height:250px}
  .hero-eyebrow{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:20px}
  .hero-h1{font-size:clamp(38px,10vw,56px);margin-bottom:12px}
  .hero-h1 .en-sub{font-size:16px}
  .hero-desc{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:32px}
  .hero-actions{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px}
  .hero-btn-primary{font-size:11px;padding:12px 24px}
  .hero-bar{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:0;margin-top:40px;padding-top:24px;
  }
  .hero-stat{
    padding:16px;margin:0;
    border-right:1px solid var(--border);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .hero-stat:nth-child(2n){border-right:none}
  .hero-stat:nth-child(3),.hero-stat:nth-child(4){border-bottom:none}
  .hero-stat-num{font-size:20px}
  .hero-scroll{display:none}

  /* Ticker */
  .ticker{height:32px}
  .ticker-item{font-size:9px;gap:8px}

  /* About */
  .about{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    padding:60px 20px;gap:40px;
    max-width:100%;
  }
  .about-right{padding-top:0}
  .about-h2{font-size:28px}
  .mvv-block{margin-bottom:32px}

  /* Biz */
  .biz-section{padding:40px 0 80px}
  .biz-header{padding:0 20px 32px;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}
  .biz-header h2{font-size:26px}
  .biz-header-right{font-size:11px}
  .biz-scroll-wrap{padding:0 20px;gap:12px}
  .biz-card{
    width:280px;padding:32px 24px;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .biz-card-num{font-size:40px}
  .biz-card-title{font-size:17px}

  /* Partner merged section */
  section[style*="padding:100px 52px"]{
    padding:60px 20px !important;
  }
  /* target the merged partner section grid */
  .partner-merged-grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr !important;
    gap:40px !important;
  }

  /* Why */
  .why{padding:60px 20px;max-width:100%}
  .why-header{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:40px}
  .why-h2{font-size:26px}
  .why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .why-card{padding:28px 20px}
  .why-num{font-size:36px}

  /* Customers */
  .customers{padding:60px 20px}
  .logo-row{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .logo-slot{min-width:calc(50% - 1px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
  .voice-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .voice-card{padding:28px 20px}

  /* Team */
  .team{padding:60px 20px;max-width:100%}
  .team-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .team-card{padding:28px 20px}

  /* CTA */
  .cta{padding:60px 20px}
  .cta-h2{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:16px}
  .cta-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0;background:none}
  .cta-card{padding:28px 20px;margin-bottom:2px}

  /* Footer */
  footer{padding:40px 20px 28px}
  .footer-inner{flex-direction:column;gap:24px;margin-bottom:32px}
  .footer-links{flex-direction:column;gap:14px}

  /* Detail pages */
  .detail-hero{padding:100px 20px 48px;min-height:auto}
  .detail-h1{font-size:clamp(28px,8vw,44px)}
  .detail-hero-body{font-size:13px}
  .detail-content{padding:48px 20px}
  .detail-2col{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .target-box{padding:24px 20px}
  .feature-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .feature-card{padding:24px 20px}
  .kobayashi-detail{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    padding:32px 20px;gap:28px;
  }
  .detail-cta-block{padding:40px 20px}
  .detail-cta-btns{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .detail-cta-btns .hero-btn-primary,
  .detail-cta-btns .btn-gold{text-align:center;justify-content:center}
  .kd-specs{flex-direction:column}
  .kd-spec{text-align:center}
}

@media(max-width:480px){
  .hero-h1{font-size:34px}
  .biz-card{width:260px}
  .team-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-bar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .member-profile-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;gap:32px !important}
  .member-content{padding:48px 20px !important}
}
@media(max-width:768px){
  .partner-spec-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr !important}
  .partner-merged-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;gap:36px !important;margin-bottom:36px !important}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .member-profile-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr !important}
  .member-photo-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
}

/* ── MEDIA SLIDER ──────────────────────── */
.media-slider-wrap{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.media-slider-track{
  display:flex;gap:16px;
  transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  will-change:transform;
}
.media-slider-card{
  flex-shrink:0;width:252px;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s;
  text-decoration:none;display:block;
}
.media-slider-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(143,184,102,.25)}
.media-slider-card-img{width:100%;height:148px;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:var(--panel)}
.media-slider-card-body{padding:14px 16px}
.media-slider-card-source{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:6px}
.media-slider-card-title{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--parchment);font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:5px}
.media-slider-card-desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.media-slider-btn{
  position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  cursor:pointer;z-index:10;transition:all .2s;
  font-size:14px;color:var(--fog);
}
.media-slider-btn:hover{background:var(--panel);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.media-slider-btn.prev{left:-18px}
.media-slider-btn.next{right:-18px}
.media-slider-btn:disabled{opacity:.25;cursor:default}
.media-slider-dots{
  display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:16px;
}
.media-slider-dot{
  width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--border);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;border:none;padding:0;
}
.media-slider-dot.active{background:var(--gold);width:18px;border-radius:3px}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .media-slider-btn{display:none}
}

</style>

<style id="gate-style">

  flex-direction:column;

  color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:48px;
}
.gate-label{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:12px;
}

  background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:var(--parchment);
  font-family:'Noto Serif JP',serif;font-size:14px;
  outline:none;margin-bottom:12px;
  transition:border-color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-align:center;
}
.gate-input:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.gate-btn{
  width:280px;padding:14px;
  background:var(--moss);color:var(--white);
  border:none;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  transition:background .2s;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 10px) 0,100% 10px,100% 100%,10px 100%,0 calc(100% - 10px));
}
.gate-btn:hover{background:var(--leaf)}
.gate-error{
  font-size:11px;color:var(--accent);
  margin-top:10px;height:16px;letter-spacing:.05em;

.gate-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--leaf);animation:blink 3s ease-in-out infinite}

<body>

<div id="gate">
  <div class="gate-logo"><span class="gate-dot"></span>School Farm</div>
  <div class="gate-sub">Internal Demo — Team Only</div>
  <div class="gate-label">パスワードを入力</div>
  <input type="password" class="gate-input" id="gate-input" placeholder="••••••••••••"
    onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')checkGate()">
  <button class="gate-btn" onclick="checkGate()">Enter →</button>
  <div class="gate-error" id="gate-error"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  // Check if already unlocked in this session
  if(sessionStorage.getItem('sf_demo_unlocked')==='1'){
    document.getElementById('gate').style.display='none';
  }
})();
function checkGate(){
  const val = document.getElementById('gate-input').value;
  const err = document.getElementById('gate-error');
  // Password: schoolfarm (チームで共有してください)
  if(val === 'schoolfarm'){
    sessionStorage.setItem('sf_demo_unlocked','1');
    const gate = document.getElementById('gate');
    gate.style.opacity='0';
    gate.style.transition='opacity .4s ease';
    setTimeout(()=>gate.style.display='none', 400);
  } else {
    err.textContent = 'パスワードが違います';
    document.getElementById('gate-input').style.borderColor='var(--accent)';
    setTimeout(()=>{
      err.textContent='';
      document.getElementById('gate-input').style.borderColor='var(--border)';
    }, 2000);
  }
}
</script>

<!-- NEWS & TOPICS -->
<section id="news" style="padding:24px 52px;background:var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)">
<style>
.news-wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:center}
.news-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:12px}
.news-tab{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 14px 6px 0;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap}
.news-tab:hover{color:var(--fog)}
.news-tab.active{color:var(--leaf);border-bottom-color:var(--leaf)}
.news-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.news-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,161,69,.08);cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.news-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.news-item:hover .news-item-title{color:var(--leaf)}
.news-item.active-item .news-item-title{color:var(--leaf)}
.news-item-date{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;min-width:64px;letter-spacing:.04em;flex-shrink:0}
.news-item-tag{display:inline-block;font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0}
.tag-release{background:rgba(143,184,102,.15);color:var(--leaf)}
.tag-update{background:rgba(200,161,69,.15);color:var(--gold)}
.tag-event{background:rgba(184,92,42,.15);color:var(--accent)}
.news-item-title{font-family:'Noto Serif JP',serif;font-size:11px;color:var(--fog);line-height:1.4;transition:color .2s;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.news-right-compact{position:relative}
.news-img-frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.news-img-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s ease;object-fit:cover;width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:36px}
.news-img-slide.active{opacity:1}
.news-img-overlay{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:10px 12px 8px;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(10,11,8,.88),transparent);z-index:2}
.news-img-caption-tag{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:2px}
.news-img-caption-title{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);line-height:1.4}
.news-img-dots{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:8px;justify-content:center}
.news-img-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border);border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;padding:0}
.news-img-dot.active{background:var(--gold);width:14px;border-radius:2px}
.news-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin-bottom:10px}
.news-header-label{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.news-header-title{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--parchment)}
@media(max-width:900px){.news-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.news-right-compact{display:none}}
@media(max-width:640px){#news{padding:20px 20px}.news-item-title{font-size:10px}}
</style>

<div class="news-wrap">
  <!-- LEFT -->
  <div>
    <div class="news-header">
      <span class="news-header-label">News</span>
      <span class="news-header-title">新着情報</span>
    </div>
    <div class="news-tabs">
      <button class="news-tab active" onclick="filterNews('all',this)">すべて</button>
      <button class="news-tab" onclick="filterNews('release',this)">リリース</button>
      <button class="news-tab" onclick="filterNews('update',this)">アップデート</button>
      <button class="news-tab" onclick="filterNews('event',this)">イベント</button>
    </div>
    <div class="news-list" id="news-list">
      <!-- ▼ ニュースをここに追加 ▼ -->
      <div class="news-item active-item" data-cat="release" data-img="0" onclick="focusNewsItem(this)">
        <div class="news-item-date">2025.XX.XX</div>
        <span class="news-item-tag tag-release">リリース</span>
        <div class="news-item-title">ニュースタイトルがここに入ります</div>
      </div>
      <div class="news-item" data-cat="update" data-img="1" onclick="focusNewsItem(this)">
        <div class="news-item-date">2025.XX.XX</div>
        <span class="news-item-tag tag-update">アップデート</span>
        <div class="news-item-title">ニュースタイトルがここに入ります</div>
      </div>
      <div class="news-item" data-cat="event" data-img="2" onclick="focusNewsItem(this)">
        <div class="news-item-date">2025.XX.XX</div>
        <span class="news-item-tag tag-event">イベント</span>
        <div class="news-item-title">ニュースタイトルがここに入ります</div>
      </div>
      <div class="news-item" data-cat="release" data-img="3" onclick="focusNewsItem(this)">
        <div class="news-item-date">2025.XX.XX</div>
        <span class="news-item-tag tag-release">リリース</span>
        <div class="news-item-title">ニュースタイトルがここに入ります</div>
      </div>
      <div class="news-item" data-cat="event" data-img="4" onclick="focusNewsItem(this)">
        <div class="news-item-date">2025.XX.XX</div>
        <span class="news-item-tag tag-event">イベント</span>
        <div class="news-item-title">ニュースタイトルがここに入ります</div>
      </div>
      <!-- ▲ 追加ここまで ▲ -->
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- RIGHT -->
  <div class="news-right-compact">
    <div class="news-img-frame" id="news-img-frame">
      <div class="news-img-slide active" data-slide="0" style="background:var(--surface)">🌱</div>
      <div class="news-img-slide" data-slide="1" style="background:var(--panel)">📰</div>
      <div class="news-img-slide" data-slide="2" style="background:var(--surface)">🎤</div>
      <div class="news-img-slide" data-slide="3" style="background:var(--panel)">🚀</div>
      <div class="news-img-slide" data-slide="4" style="background:var(--surface)">🤝</div>
      <div class="news-img-overlay">
        <div class="news-img-caption-tag" id="news-cap-tag">リリース</div>
        <div class="news-img-caption-title" id="news-cap-title">ニュースタイトルがここに入ります</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="news-img-dots" id="news-dots"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const items   = document.querySelectorAll('.news-item');
  const slides  = document.querySelectorAll('.news-img-slide');
  const capTag  = document.getElementById('news-cap-tag');
  const capTitle= document.getElementById('news-cap-title');
  const dotsWrap= document.getElementById('news-dots');
  items.forEach((item,i)=>{
    const d=document.createElement('button');
    d.className='news-img-dot'+(i===0?' active':'');
    d.onclick=()=>focusNewsItem(item);
    dotsWrap.appendChild(d);
  });
  window.focusNewsItem=function(el){
    document.querySelectorAll('.news-item').forEach(it=>it.classList.remove('active-item'));
    el.classList.add('active-item');
    const idx=parseInt(el.dataset.img||'0');
    slides.forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
    const t=document.querySelector('.news-img-slide[data-slide="'+idx+'"]');
    if(t)t.classList.add('active');
    const tag=el.querySelector('.news-item-tag');
    const title=el.querySelector('.news-item-title');
    if(capTag)capTag.textContent=tag?tag.textContent:'';
    if(capTitle)capTitle.textContent=title?title.textContent:'';
    const allItems=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.news-item'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.news-img-dot').forEach((d,i)=>d.classList.toggle('active',i===allItems.indexOf(el)));
  };
  window.filterNews=function(cat,btn){
    document.querySelectorAll('.news-tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    const vis=[];
    document.querySelectorAll('.news-item').forEach(item=>{
      const show=cat==='all'||item.dataset.cat===cat;
      item.style.display=show?'':'none';
      if(show)vis.push(item);
    });
    if(vis.length)focusNewsItem(vis[0]);
  };
  let autoIdx=0;
  const visItems=()=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.news-item')).filter(i=>i.style.display!=='none');
  setInterval(()=>{
    const vis=visItems();if(!vis.length)return;
    autoIdx=(autoIdx+1)%vis.length;
    focusNewsItem(vis[autoIdx]);
  },2000);
})();
</script>
</section>

<script>
(function(){
  const imgs = [document.getElementById('pimg-0'), document.getElementById('pimg-1')];
  const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.pdot');
  const labelSub  = document.getElementById('partner-label-sub');
  const labelMain = document.getElementById('partner-label-main');
  const caption   = document.getElementById('partner-caption');

  const data = [
    { sub: 'Partnership — 2025', main: '小林精密工業 × School Farm 提携', cap: 'Partnership — 2025' },
    { sub: 'Product', main: '水耕栽培ユニット — オフィス専用設計', cap: 'SF-Unit 01' }
  ];

  let current = 0;

  function switchPartnerImg(idx) {
    imgs[current].style.opacity = '0';
    dots[current].style.width  = '8px';
    dots[current].style.background = 'rgba(200,161,69,.25)';

    current = idx;

    imgs[current].style.opacity = '1';
    dots[current].style.width  = '24px';
    dots[current].style.background = 'var(--gold)';

    labelSub.textContent  = data[current].sub;
    labelMain.textContent = data[current].main;
    caption.textContent   = data[current].cap;
  }

  window.switchPartnerImg = switchPartnerImg;

  // Auto-switch every 4 seconds
  setInterval(function() {
    switchPartnerImg((current + 1) % imgs.length);
  }, 4000);
})();
</script>

<!-- WHY -->
<section class="why">
  <div class="why-header reveal">
    <h2 class="why-h2">「置いてよかった」と思える<br>理由がある。</h2>
    <p class="why-sub">精密技術・自動化・データ活用・福祉連携——4つのレイヤーが重なって初めて、School Farm の品質が生まれます。</p>
  </div>
  <div class="why-grid reveal">
    <div class="why-card">
      <div class="why-num">01</div>
      <div class="why-title">精密メーカーの技術が安心を作る</div>
      <p class="why-body">小林精密工業との共同開発。水漏れリスクを工業規格で徹底排除し、「品質が心配」という稟議の壁を数字で超えます。</p>
    </div>
    <div class="why-card">
      <div class="why-num">02</div>
      <div class="why-title">手間なく、続けられる設計</div>
      <p class="why-body">水やり・栄養管理・光はすべて自動化。ユーザーがすることは苗のセットと収穫だけ。月15分以内で運用できます。</p>
    </div>
    <div class="why-card">
      <div class="why-num">03</div>
      <div class="why-title">実績データが自動で残る</div>
      <p class="why-body">収穫量・CO₂削減貢献・参加人数などのデータを自動レポート化。サステナビリティレポートにそのまま活用できます。</p>
    </div>
    <div class="why-card">
      <div class="why-num">04</div>
      <div class="why-title">苗から保守まで、ワンストップ</div>
      <p class="why-body">育苗（自社ラボ）・設置・定期メンテまで、School Farmとパートナーが担います。「困ったら誰に？」がない体制。</p>
    </div>
    <div class="why-card">
      <div class="why-num">05</div>
      <div class="why-title">育苗ラボは障害者雇用で運営</div>
      <p class="why-body">届ける苗はすべて自社育苗ラボで栽培。障害者雇用のメンバーが中心となり、丁寧な手作業で高品質な苗を供給します。</p>
    </div>
    <div class="why-card">
      <div class="why-num">06</div>
      <div class="why-title">農業人口1億人への本気</div>
      <p class="why-body">福利厚生・産業・家庭・教育の4軸で社会実装することで、「育てる文化」を点ではなく面として広げていきます。</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

.case-result{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;
  font-size:12px;color:var(--leaf);line-height:1.7;
}
.case-result::before{content:'→';flex-shrink:0}
/* Voice strip */
.voice-strip{
  background:var(--deep);border:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:52px;margin-bottom:64px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:48px;position:relative;
}
.voice-strip::before{
  content:'VOICE';
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:80px;color:rgba(200,161,69,.04);

}

  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.voice-from::before{content:'';width:16px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-dim);display:inline-block}
/* Stat bar */
.stat-bar{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:2px;background:var(--border);
}
.stat-cell{
  background:var(--surface);padding:32px 24px;text-align:center;
}

}
.stat-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1.6}
/* Coming soon badge */
.coming-badge{

  padding:3px 8px;
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .case-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .voice-strip{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .stat-bar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media(max-width:640px){

  .stat-bar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}

        <p class="case-challenge">天候による収穫量の不安定さと、品質のばらつきが課題。安定した出荷計画が立てられず、食品メーカーとの契約に影響が出ていた。</p>
        <div class="case-result">精密センサーによる環境制御で収穫量の安定化に成功。年間を通じた安定出荷体制を構築。</div>
      </div>

      <div class="case-card" data-case="school">
        <span class="coming-badge">掲載準備中</span>
        <span class="case-tag case-tag-school">教育</span>
        <div class="case-company">D小学校</div>
        <div class="case-industry">公立小学校 ／ 生活科・理科</div>
        <div class="case-divider"></div>
        <p class="case-challenge">食育の授業を充実させたいが、校庭での栽培は天候・管理の問題があり継続が難しかった。</p>
        <div class="case-result">教室内で年間を通じた栽培・収穫・試食プログラムを実施。子どもたちの食への関心が大きく変化。</div>
      </div>

      <div class="case-card" data-case="partner">
        <span class="coming-badge">掲載準備中</span>
        <span class="case-tag case-tag-partner">連携団体</span>
        <div class="case-company">就労支援施設 E</div>
        <div class="case-industry">就労継続支援事業所 ／ 障害者雇用</div>
        <div class="case-divider"></div>
        <p class="case-challenge">安定した業務と就労機会の確保が課題。天候に左右されない、再現性の高い作業が求められていた。</p>
        <div class="case-result">育苗・パッキング業務を担当。School Farmの供給ラボとして、安定した雇用と高品質な苗の供給を両立。</div>
      </div>

      <div class="case-card" data-case="partner">

        <span class="case-tag case-tag-partner">連携団体</span>

        <div class="case-industry">NPO ／ 地域活性化・食育推進</div>

        <div class="case-result">School Farmのユニットを活用した地域向け食育ワークショップを定期開催。参加者が継続的に増加。</div>

window.filterCases = function(cat, btn){
  document.querySelectorAll('.customer-tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.case-card').forEach(card=>{

};

.carousel-track{

}
function closeMobileMenu(){
  document.getElementById('hamburger').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('mobile-menu').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}

// ── Page routing
function showPage(id){
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  const t=document.getElementById('page-'+id);
  if(t){t.classList.add('active');window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});}
}
function scrollToSection(sel){
  const el=document.querySelector(sel);
  if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
}

// ── Counter animation (1億 = 100,000,000)
function animateCounter(){
  const el=document.getElementById('counter');
  if(!el)return;
  const target=100000000;
  const duration=2800;
  const start=performance.now();
  const fmt=n=>{
    if(n>=100000000)return'1億';
    if(n>=10000)return Math.floor(n/10000).toLocaleString()+'万';
    return n.toLocaleString();
  };
  function step(now){
    const p=Math.min((now-start)/duration,1);
    const ease=1-Math.pow(1-p,4);
    el.textContent=fmt(Math.floor(ease*target));
    if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);
    else el.textContent='1億';
  }
  setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(step),600);
}
animateCounter();

// ── Custom cursor
const cursor=document.getElementById('cursor');
const ring=document.getElementById('cursor-ring');
let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cursor.style.left=mx+'px';cursor.style.top=my+'px';});
(function lerp(){
  rx+=(mx-rx)*.12;ry+=(my-ry)*.12;
  ring.style.left=rx+'px';ring.style.top=ry+'px';
  requestAnimationFrame(lerp);
})();

// ── Scroll reveal
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('visible')});
},{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal,.biz-card,.why-card,.team-card,.voice-card,.spec-item,.feature-card,.mvv-block').forEach(el=>{
  el.classList.add('reveal');obs.observe(el);
});
</script>

        <h2 style="font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:30px;font-weight:700;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:4px">木寺 達士</h2>
        <p style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:28px">Tatsushi Kidera</p>

        <!-- ② キャッチフレーズ -->
        <div style="border-left:3px solid var(--leaf);padding:2px 0 2px 20px;margin-bottom:28px">
          <p style="font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:18px;color:var(--parchment);line-height:1.7;font-weight:500">「自分で作り、自分で食べる。<br>これ以上、贅沢な生き方があるだろうか。」</p>
        </div>

        <!-- ③ プロフィール文 -->
        <div style="font-size:14px;line-height:2.3;color:var(--muted)">
          <p style="font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:8px">農業を安定経済へ。外の土で見えた限界と、水耕栽培への挑戦</p>
          <p>前職で新規就農者の支援に奔走する中で、私は一つの壁にぶつかりました。天候や環境に左右される「外の土」の農業が抱える過酷さと限界です。農業を、一部の志ある人の犠牲の上に成り立つものではなく、誰もが参画できる「安定した経済」へと変えなければならない。その一心で辿り着いたのが水耕栽培でした。</p>
          <br>
          <p>しかし、当時の水耕栽培業界は、どこかDIYの延長線上の域を出ていないようにも見えました。「確かな技術力さえあれば、この世界はもっと良くなる」という確信。そして何より、誰がどう作ったかもわからないものを買い、食べるのが当たり前になった現代文化に、私は恐怖を覚えました。それは、人間らしさをどこかに置き忘れた姿に思えたのです。</p>
          <br>
          <p style="font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:8px">歴史ある町工場の技術×マーケティング。運命の直訴から始まった「School Farm」</p>
          <p>「農業を絶望から希望へ、そして稼げる業界へ」。その空気を本気で作るためには、圧倒的な技術力が必要でした。そんな時に出会ったのが、40年続く町工場、コバヤシ精密工業の小林昌純さんです。40年の歴史を背負いながら、スタートアップとして新たな挑戦を始める――。その「既存の継承」と「未来への変容」を同時に体現する小林さんの理念に深く感動した私は、「コバヤシの技術力を、僕のマーケティングで世界に広めさせてほしい」と直接直訴しました。この運命的な出会いによって、日本の精密な職人技と農のビジョンが融合したプロジェクト『School Farm』が産声を上げました。</p>
          <br>
          <p style="font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:8px">食は、生命のインフラ。1億人が「作る手」を持つ未来へ</p>
          <p>私は、農業を単なる産業ではなく、人間が生きていくための「究極のインフラ」だと考えています。仮にインターネットがなくなっても、AIが機能しなくなっても、人は生きていける。けれど、食や農業がなくなれば、私たちは生きていくことができません。私の目標は、「一家に一台の水耕栽培」を当たり前にすること。自分で食べるものは、自分で作る。その「作る手」を1億人が持つことこそが、この国の本当の強さになると確信しています。School Farmから、日本の、そしてあなたの日常の景色を変えていく。</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

<style>
.mp-kobayashi .mpage-hero{min-height:46vh;padding:100px 52px 56px;background:var(--deep);position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.mpage-inner-kobayashi{max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;padding:80px 52px}
.mpage-profile-kobayashi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:52px;align-items:start;margin-bottom:64px}
.mpage-photo-kobayashi{width:200px;height:240px;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:72px;flex-shrink:0}
.mpage-photo-kobayashi img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top}
.mpage-sns-kobayashi{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mpage-slabel{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.mpage-slabel::before{content:'';width:24px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-dim);display:inline-block}
.mpage-block-kobayashi{margin-bottom:60px;padding-top:48px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
/* other biz */
.biz-oth-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:18px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;transition:border-color .2s;text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:10px;border-radius:4px}
.biz-oth-card:hover{border-color:rgba(143,184,102,.3);background:var(--panel)}
.biz-oth-name{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:3px}
.biz-oth-url{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.08em}
.biz-oth-arrow{font-size:14px;color:var(--gold);opacity:.6;flex-shrink:0}
/* media scroll */
.media-scroll-kobayashi{overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding-bottom:12px;margin:0 -52px;padding-left:52px}
.media-scroll-kobayashi::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.media-track-kobayashi{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;padding-right:52px}
.mcard{width:252px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s;text-decoration:none;display:block}
.mcard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(143,184,102,.25)}
.mcard-img{width:100%;height:148px;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:var(--panel)}
.mcard-body{padding:14px 16px}
.mcard-source{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:6px}
.mcard-title{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--parchment);font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:5px}
.mcard-desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.mcard-add{width:252px;flex-shrink:0;background:transparent;border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:240px}
.mcard-add-inner{text-align:center;padding:24px}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .mp-kobayashi .mpage-hero{padding:100px 20px 44px}
  .mpage-inner-kobayashi{padding:48px 20px}
  .mpage-profile-kobayashi{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .mpage-photo-kobayashi{width:140px;height:168px;margin:0 auto}
  .mpage-sns-kobayashi{justify-content:center}
  .media-scroll-kobayashi{margin:0 -20px;padding-left:20px}
  .media-track-kobayashi{padding-right:20px}
}
</style>

.mcard-desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.mcard-add{width:252px;flex-shrink:0;background:transparent;border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:240px}

<script>
// ── Media Slider (Infinite Loop) ───────────────
function initMediaSlider(wrapId){
  const wrap = document.getElementById(wrapId);
  if(!wrap) return;

  const origCards = Array.from(wrap.querySelectorAll('.media-slider-card'));
  if(!origCards.length) return;

  const track  = wrap.querySelector('.media-slider-track');
  const prev   = wrap.querySelector('.media-slider-btn.prev');
  const next   = wrap.querySelector('.media-slider-btn.next');
  const dotsEl = wrap.querySelector('.media-slider-dots');

  const CARD_W = 252 + 16; // card + gap
  const CLONE_COUNT = 3;   // clones on each side

  // ── Clone cards for infinite feel
  // Prepend clones of last N cards, append clones of first N cards
  const total = origCards.length;
  const clonesBefore = origCards.slice(-CLONE_COUNT).map(c=>{const cl=c.cloneNode(true);cl.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');return cl;});
  const clonesAfter  = origCards.slice(0, CLONE_COUNT).map(c=>{const cl=c.cloneNode(true);cl.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');return cl;});

  // Clear and rebuild track
  track.innerHTML = '';
  clonesBefore.forEach(c=>track.appendChild(c));
  origCards.forEach(c=>track.appendChild(c));
  clonesAfter.forEach(c=>track.appendChild(c));

  let current = CLONE_COUNT; // start at first real card
  let timer   = null;
  let paused  = false;
  let transitioning = false;

  // Dots
  let dots = [];
  if(dotsEl){
    dotsEl.innerHTML='';
    for(let i=0;i<total;i++){
      const d=document.createElement('button');
      d.className='media-slider-dot'+(i===0?' active':'');
      d.onclick=()=>{goTo(i+CLONE_COUNT,true);restartTimer()};
      dotsEl.appendChild(d);
      dots.push(d);
    }
  }

  function updateDots(){
    const realIdx = ((current - CLONE_COUNT) % total + total) % total;
    dots.forEach((d,i)=>d.classList.toggle('active', i===realIdx));
  }

  function setPos(idx, animate){
    if(!animate){
      track.style.transition = 'none';
    } else {
      track.style.transition = 'transform .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)';
      transitioning = true;
    }
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${idx * CARD_W}px)`;
  }

  function goTo(idx, animate=true){
    current = idx;
    setPos(current, animate);
    updateDots();
  }

  // After transition ends: jump silently if on clones
  track.addEventListener('transitionend', ()=>{
    transitioning = false;
    if(current < CLONE_COUNT){
      current = current + total;
      setPos(current, false);
    } else if(current >= CLONE_COUNT + total){
      current = current - total;
      setPos(current, false);
    }
    updateDots();
  });

  function advance(dir){
    if(transitioning) return;
    goTo(current + dir);
  }

  function startTimer(){
    if(timer) clearInterval(timer);
    timer = setInterval(()=>{ if(!paused) advance(1); }, 3000);
  }
  function stopTimer(){ clearInterval(timer); timer=null; }
  function restartTimer(){ stopTimer(); startTimer(); }

  if(prev) prev.onclick=()=>{advance(-1);restartTimer()};
  if(next) next.onclick=()=>{advance(1);restartTimer()};

  // Hover pause
  wrap.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{paused=true});
  wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{paused=false});

  // Swipe
  let startX=0;
  track.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{startX=e.touches[0].clientX;paused=true},{passive:true});
  track.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{
    const dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-startX;
    if(Math.abs(dx)>40) advance(dx<0?1:-1);
    paused=false;
    restartTimer();
  },{passive:true});

  // Init
  setPos(current, false);
  updateDots();
  startTimer();
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('.media-slider-wrap').forEach(w=>initMediaSlider(w.id));
});

const _origShow = window.showPage;
window.showPage = function(id){
  _origShow(id);
  setTimeout(()=>{
    const pg = document.getElementById('page-'+id);
    if(!pg) return;
    pg.querySelectorAll('.media-slider-wrap').forEach(w=>{
      // reset and re-init
      const track = w.querySelector('.media-slider-track');
      if(track) track.style.transition='none';
      initMediaSlider(w.id);
    });
  }, 60);
};
</script>

          <p class="mfg-feature-body">汎用プラスチックではなく工業用グレードの耐食性素材を採用。長期間の安定稼働を実現します。</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- CTA -->
    <div class="mfg-cta-block">

      <p style="font-size:14px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:32px">製品の詳細・導入費用・スケジュールについて、個別にご説明します。</p>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap">
        <button class="hero-btn-primary" onclick="showPage('home');setTimeout(()=>scrollToSection('#cta'),100)">導入を相談する →</button>
        <a href="https://kobasei.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn-gold" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:12px 28px;border:1px solid var(--gold-dim);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:all .2s" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--gold)';this.style.color='var(--ink)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='transparent';this.style.color='var(--gold)'">公式サイトを見る ↗</a>
      </div>

<!-- ════════════ PAGE: Our Purpose ════════════ -->
<div id="page-purpose" class="page">
<style>
.purpose-hero{min-height:55vh;padding:100px 52px 72px;background:var(--ink);position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.purpose-inner{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:80px 52px}
.purpose-slabel{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.purpose-slabel::before{content:'';width:24px;height:1px;background:var(--gold-dim);display:inline-block}
.purpose-block{margin-bottom:80px;padding-top:64px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.purpose-block:first-of-type{padding-top:0;border-top:none}
.purpose-h2{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:clamp(26px,3.5vw,40px);font-weight:700;color:var(--parchment);line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:32px}
.purpose-h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--leaf)}
.purpose-body{font-size:14px;line-height:2.4;color:var(--muted)}
.purpose-body p{margin-bottom:20px}
.purpose-2col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:start}
.purpose-quote{border-left:3px solid var(--leaf);padding:12px 0 12px 28px;margin:32px 0}
.purpose-quote p{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--parchment);line-height:1.7;font-weight:500}
.purpose-value-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2px;background:var(--border);margin-top:48px}
.purpose-value-card{background:var(--surface);padding:36px 28px;border-top:2px solid transparent;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s}
.purpose-value-card:hover{background:var(--panel);border-top-color:var(--leaf)}
.purpose-value-num{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:48px;color:rgba(200,161,69,.12);line-height:1;margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:400}
.purpose-value-title{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:12px}
.purpose-value-body{font-size:12px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted)}
.purpose-mvv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0;margin-top:48px}
.purpose-mvv-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.purpose-mvv-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.purpose-mvv-label-col{padding:32px 24px 32px 0;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.purpose-mvv-label{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.purpose-mvv-content{padding:32px 0 32px 40px}
.purpose-mvv-title{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:12px}
.purpose-mvv-body{font-size:13px;line-height:2.1;color:var(--muted)}
.purpose-impact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:32px}
.purpose-impact-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:28px;transition:border-color .2s}
.purpose-impact-card:hover{border-color:rgba(143,184,102,.25)}
.purpose-impact-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
.purpose-impact-title{font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--parchment);margin-bottom:8px}
.purpose-impact-body{font-size:12px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:768px){
  .purpose-hero{padding:100px 20px 48px}
  .purpose-inner{padding:48px 20px}
  .purpose-2col{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
  .purpose-value-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .purpose-mvv-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .purpose-mvv-label-col{border-right:none;padding:24px 0 0}
  .purpose-mvv-content{padding:12px 0 24px}
  .purpose-impact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>

  <!-- Hero -->
  <div class="purpose-hero">
    <div class="detail-hero-grid-bg"></div>
    <div class="detail-hero-orb" style="background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(143,184,102,.25),transparent 70%)"></div>
    <div style="max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;position:relative;z-index:2">
      <button class="detail-back" onclick="showPage('home');setTimeout(()=>scrollToSection('#about'),100)">
        <span class="detail-back-line"></span> School Farm Top
      </button>
      <div class="detail-eyebrow">Our Purpose</div>
      <h1 class="detail-h1" style="font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,64px)">"買う"を捨てて、<br><span style="color:var(--leaf)">"創る"を選ぶ</span>社会へ。</h1>
      <p style="font-size:15px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted);max-width:560px;margin-top:20px">人も企業も、外から買う前提で生きてきた。でも本質は違う。自分で創れる社会は、もっと強くて、おもしろい。</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="purpose-inner">

    <!-- ① Purpose -->
    <div class="purpose-block">
      <div class="purpose-slabel">Purpose — 存在意義</div>
      <div class="purpose-2col">
        <div>
          <h2 class="purpose-h2">「創る」という構造を、<br><em>社会に実装する。</em></h2>
          <div class="purpose-body">
            <p>都市は長い間、「消費するだけの場所」でした。食べるものはスーパーで買い、使うものは外注し、価値は外部から調達するのが当たり前になっていた。</p>
            <p>しかし、誰がどう作ったかもわからないものを買い続ける生活に、私たちは根本的な問いを感じています。それは豊かさではなく、依存ではないか、と。</p>
            <p>School Farm は、ハードと仕組みで「創る」を都市インフラとして根付かせる会社です。オフィスの一角で、家庭の窓際で、学校の教室で——育てることが「あたりまえ」になる社会を、実装していきます。</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="purpose-quote">
            <p>「自分で作り、自分で食べる。<br>これ以上、贅沢な生き方があるだろうか。」</p>
          </div>
          <div class="purpose-body">
            <p>農業は、畑だけで行うものではなくなった。精密技術・データ・デザインを組み合わせることで、誰もが「育てる側」に回れる時代が来ています。</p>
            <p>その入口を、私たちはB2Bから作ります。オフィスで体験した「育てる文化」が、社員の家庭へ、子どもへ、地域へと伝播していく。</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ② Mission / Vision -->
    <div class="purpose-block">
      <div class="purpose-slabel">Mission & Vision</div>
      <h2 class="purpose-h2">何を実現するために、<br>存在するのか。</h2>
      <div class="purpose-mvv-grid">
        <div class="purpose-mvv-row">
          <div class="purpose-mvv-label-col">
            <div class="purpose-mvv-label">Mission</div>
          </div>
          <div class="purpose-mvv-content">
            <div class="purpose-mvv-title">育てる体験を、法人から家庭へ広げる。</div>
            <p class="purpose-mvv-body">企業・学校・家庭に水耕栽培環境を届け、「育てる体験」をした人がその文化を日常に持ち帰る。1台の導入が周りの人を巻き込み、農業人口を増やしていく連鎖を設計します。B2Bから市場を創り、最終的に家庭にも広がる新たな食の文化をつくる——それが School Farm の実行戦略です。</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-mvv-row">
          <div class="purpose-mvv-label-col">
            <div class="purpose-mvv-label">Vision</div>
          </div>
          <div class="purpose-mvv-content">
            <div class="purpose-mvv-title">水耕栽培を、あたりまえの選択肢に。</div>
            <p class="purpose-mvv-body">観葉植物を置くように、水耕栽培ユニットを置く。外食を選ぶように、自分で育てた野菜を選ぶ。「一家に一台の水耕栽培」が当然になる社会をつくります。農業人口1億人——その言葉は単なるスローガンではなく、School Farm が取りに行く具体的なポジションです。</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-mvv-row">
          <div class="purpose-mvv-label-col">
            <div class="purpose-mvv-label">Value</div>
          </div>
          <div class="purpose-mvv-content">
            <div class="purpose-mvv-title">共に育てる。共に変わる。</div>
            <p class="purpose-mvv-body">植物が育つスピードに合わせて、関わる人も組織も少しずつ変わっていく。School Farm は、その変化に伴走します。数値・証拠への集中、スピード最優先、再現性のある仕組み化——私たちの行動基準は常に「構造が社会を動かす」という思想から来ています。</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ③ Values -->
    <div class="purpose-block">
      <div class="purpose-slabel">Our Values — 行動基準</div>
      <h2 class="purpose-h2">個人の頑張りではなく、<br><em>構造が社会を動かす。</em></h2>
      <div class="purpose-value-grid">
        <div class="purpose-value-card">
          <div class="purpose-value-num">01</div>
          <div class="purpose-value-title">数値・証拠への集中</div>
          <p class="purpose-value-body">すべての成果は数値化する。主観表現は禁止し、母集団・比較・変化量で評価する。データに基づかない意思決定は行わない。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-value-card">
          <div class="purpose-value-num">02</div>
          <div class="purpose-value-title">スピード最優先</div>
          <p class="purpose-value-body">初期アウトプットは最速で提出する。完成度よりも検証スピードを重視する。10点のプロトタイプを即出しする文化が、手戻りを80%削減する。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-value-card">
          <div class="purpose-value-num">03</div>
          <div class="purpose-value-title">再現性のある仕組み化</div>
          <p class="purpose-value-body">個人の力量に依存しないプロセスを構築する。一度作った仕組みは資産化し、次回以降の工数を削減する。誰がやっても同じ品質を出せる状態にする。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-value-card">
          <div class="purpose-value-num">04</div>
          <div class="purpose-value-title">構造の責任を明確化する</div>
          <p class="purpose-value-body">問題は個人の能力ではなくプロセスの構造で発生するものとして扱う。発生した課題は即座にプロセスを修正し再発を防ぐ。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-value-card">
          <div class="purpose-value-num">05</div>
          <div class="purpose-value-title">リソース集中</div>
          <p class="purpose-value-body">優先順位を明確化し、リソースを一つの重要領域に集中させる。効果の低いタスクを同時並行しない。限られたリソースで最大の成果を出す。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-value-card">
          <div class="purpose-value-num">06</div>
          <div class="purpose-value-title">独自戦略の開発</div>
          <p class="purpose-value-body">競合と同じ行動を取らず、差別化可能な戦略を常に検討する。定性的判断ではなく、戦略的合理性に基づいて施策を決定する。</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ④ Impact -->
    <div class="purpose-block">
      <div class="purpose-slabel">Social Impact — 社会へのインパクト</div>
      <h2 class="purpose-h2">School Farm が実現する、<br><em>4つの変化。</em></h2>
      <div class="purpose-impact-grid">
        <div class="purpose-impact-card">
          <span class="purpose-impact-icon">🌆</span>
          <div class="purpose-impact-title">都市が「生産できる場所」になる</div>
          <p class="purpose-impact-body">消費するだけだった都市空間が、食を生産できる場所に変わる。オフィスのデッドスペースが生産拠点になり、不動産面積あたりの付加価値が向上する。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-impact-card">
          <span class="purpose-impact-icon">🥗</span>
          <div class="purpose-impact-title">食の距離がゼロになる</div>
          <p class="purpose-impact-body">収穫直前に消費するから、輸送コストも食品ロスもない。フードマイルのゼロ化が、サプライチェーンの負荷を下げ、CO₂削減の実績として可視化される。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-impact-card">
          <span class="purpose-impact-icon">🏫</span>
          <div class="purpose-impact-title">地域・教育が創る力を持つ</div>
          <p class="purpose-impact-body">学校で育てた野菜を食べた子どもが、家庭でも育てたいと思う。企業で体験した社員が自宅に持ち帰る。教育と日常が農業でつながる社会をつくる。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="purpose-impact-card">
          <span class="purpose-impact-icon">🛡️</span>
          <div class="purpose-impact-title">食のレジリエンスが上がる</div>
          <p class="purpose-impact-body">日本の食料自給率は38%。物流が止まれば都市は3日で食料が枯渇する。「一家に一台の水耕栽培」は、災害時の食のインフラにもなりうる。</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Back CTA -->
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:48px 32px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px">
      <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px">School Farm の事業について、もっと知る</p>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap">
        <button onclick="showPage('home');setTimeout(()=>scrollToSection('#businesses'),100)" class="hero-btn-primary">事業を見る →</button>
        <button onclick="showPage('home');setTimeout(()=>scrollToSection('#cta'),100)" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:12px 28px;border:1px solid var(--gold-dim);color:var(--gold);background:transparent;font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--gold)';this.style.color='var(--ink)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='transparent';this.style.color='var(--gold)'">お問い合わせ</button>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <footer>
    <div class="footer-inner">
      <div><div class="footer-logo"><span class="nav-dot"></span>School Farm</div><div class="footer-tagline">農業人口を1億人にする会社</div></div>
      <ul class="footer-links"><li><a onclick="showPage('home')">トップへ戻る</a></li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="footer-bottom">© 2025 School Farm, Inc.</div>
  </footer>
